entries.source:
While Highers are not meant to rule other humans - and show no particular will to do so - they are frequently called to higher duties.
		Their nature grants them better senses than other humans.
		Increase blindness immunity by %d%%, maximum sight range by %d, and increases existing infravision, and heightened senses range by %d.
		At talent level 5, each time you hit a target you gain telepathy to all similar creatures in radius 15 for 5 turns.
entries.target:
虽然高等人类并非生来就要统治他人——他们也没有特别的意愿去那样做——但是他们经常承担更高的义务。
		他们的天性赋予他们比其他人类更敏锐的感官。
		增加 %d%% 目盲免疫，最大视野范围提高 %d 格，夜视及感应范围提高 %d 格。
		技能等级 5 时，每次你命中目标，你将获得对 15 格范围内所有同类生物的感知能力，持续 5 回合。

entries.source:
You are trained in an agile, mobile fighting technique combining sling and shield. This allows shields to be equipped, using Dexterity instead of Strength as a requirement.
While you have a shield equip and your Block talent is not on cooldown, you have a %d%% chance to deflect any incoming damage, reducing it by 50%% of your shield’s block value.
entries.target:
你学会了在战斗中灵敏使用投石索和盾牌的技巧。允许你装备盾牌，用敏捷代替力量需求。
当你装备盾牌，且格挡技能未进入冷却时，有 %d%% 几率偏转任何受到的伤害，减免相当于盾牌格挡值 50%% 的伤害。

entries.source:
Gnaw your target for %d%% damage.  If your attack hits, the target may be infected with Ghoul Rot for %d turns.
		Each turn, Ghoul Rot inflicts %0.2f blight damage.
		Targets suffering from Ghoul Rot rise as friendly ghouls when slain.
		Ghouls last for %d turns and can use Gnaw, Ghoulish Leap, Stun, and Rotting Disease.
		The blight damage scales with your Constitution.
entries.target:
啃噬目标，造成 %d%% 伤害。如果你的攻击命中，目标可能感染食尸鬼腐疫，持续 %d 回合。
		食尸鬼腐疫每回合造成 %0.2f 枯萎伤害。
		感染食尸鬼腐疫的目标被杀死时，会变成为你作战的友方食尸鬼。
		这些食尸鬼持续 %d 回合，可以使用啃噬、食尸鬼跳跃、震慑和腐烂疫病。
		受体质影响，枯萎伤害按比例加成。

entries.source: #Target# is free from the ghoul rot.
entries.target: #Target#摆脱了食尸鬼腐疫。

entries.source: #Target#'s solar fury subsides.
entries.target: #Target#身上的太阳之力消退了。

entries.source: Target is drenched with magical water, halving its stun resistance.
entries.target: 目标全身被魔法之水浸透，震慑抗性减半。

entries.source: #Target# has returned to its natural state.
entries.target: #Target#恢复了原本的状态。

entries.source: The target is being removed from the timeline and is taking %0.2f temporal damage per turn.
entries.target: 目标被移出时间线，每回合受到 %0.2f 时空伤害。

entries.source: The target is poisoned and sick, doing %0.2f blight damage per turn. Each time it tries to use a talent there is %d%% chance of failure.
entries.target: 目标中毒且患病，每回合受到 %0.2f 枯萎伤害，每次使用技能时有 %d%% 概率失败。

entries.source: #Target#'s can be afflicted again.
entries.target: #Target#又会受到异常状态的影响了。

entries.target: 凛霜冰魂的宿主！

entries.source: Host of a Rime Wraith (Gelid Host)!
entries.target: 凛霜冰魂的宿主（霜寒宿主）！

entries.target: 目标受到负面状态效果时，获得护盾

entries.target: #Target#恢复了些许意志。

entries.target: 猎物伤害修正：%d%%。

entries.target: 目标被 %s 追踪。追踪者增益层数 %d：+%d 命中，+%d%% 近战伤害，命中猎物的每回合 +%0.2f 仇恨值。

entries.target: 猎物伤害修正：%d%%。

entries.target: %s 陷入极度痛苦，承受的伤害从 %d 逐步升至 %d，持续 %d 回合。

entries.source: Your tyranny is increasing your Mindpower and Physicalpower by 2 for each fear applied, for a total of %d
entries.target: 你的专制使你的精神强度和物理强度每施加一次恐惧提升2点，合计 %d点。

entries.source: The target has been panicked by %s, causing them to have a %d%% chance of fleeing in terror instead of acting.
entries.target: 目标对 %s 感到恐慌，使其有 %d%% 概率因为害怕而逃跑，无法正常行动。

entries.target: #Target#进入念力射击状态！

entries.target: +念力射击

entries.source: #Target# is no longer in a telekinetic archer's trance.
entries.target: #Target#脱离了念力射击状态。

entries.target: #Target#被虚空逼得发狂。

entries.target: 清醒梦魇

entries.source: #Target#'s awareness returns to normal.
entries.target: #Target#的感知恢复了正常。

entries.source: #F53CBE#Your rampage is invigorated by the intense onslaught! (+1 duration)
entries.target: #F53CBE#承受的猛烈攻击强化了你的暴走！（+1持续时间）

entries.source: Nullifies the next %d detrimental mental effects.
entries.target: 使接下来的 %d 次负面精神效果无效。

entries.source: #Target#'s subconscious has been focused.
entries.target: #Target#的潜意识集中了起来。

entries.source: #Target#'s subconscious has returned to normal.
entries.target: #Target#的潜意识恢复了正常。

entries.source: #Target# had a restless night.
entries.target: #Target#度过了不安的一夜。

entries.source: The target is wide awake and has %d%% resistance to sleep effects.
entries.target: 目标清醒并获得 %d%% 睡眠效果抵抗。

entries.source: Detect nearby thoughts, revealing creature locations in a radius of %d and boosting defense by %d.
entries.target: 探测周围的思维，揭示半径 %d 以内的生物位置，并增加你的闪避 %d 点。

entries.source: Your telekinesis transcends normal limits. +%d Physical damage and +%d%% Physical damage penetration, and improved kinetic effects.
entries.target: 你的动能操控能力超越了极限，增加 %d%% 物理伤害与 %d%% 物理抗性穿透，同时你的动能效果得到强化。

entries.source: The shadow is out of sight of its host; direct control will be lost!
entries.target: 阴影在宿主的视线以外，你将失去对它的控制！

entries.source: The target has been affected by space or time manipulations and is becoming more resistant to them (+%d).
entries.target: 目标受时空操纵的影响，对此类效果的豁免提升（+%d）。

entries.source: #Target# is firmly planted in reality.
entries.target: #Target#重新稳固于现实之中。

entries.source: The more the target summons creatures the longer it will take to summon more (+%d turns).
entries.target: 目标召唤的生物越多，召唤技能的冷却时间越长（+%d 回合）。

entries.source: The target is enveloped in a shroud that seems to not only obscure it but also to fade its form (+%d%% resist all).
entries.target: 目标被帷幕笼罩，帷幕似乎不仅遮蔽其身形，还使之逐渐消散（+%d%% 全体抗性）。

entries.source: A formless terror that seems to cut through the air, and its victims, like a knife.
entries.target: 这只形态模糊的恐魔仿佛利刃，划破空气，也划开它的猎物。

entries.source: #LIGHT_RED#%s suffered a %s of self in the Dreamscape!
entries.target: #LIGHT_RED#%s的自我在梦境空间中遭受了%s！

entries.source: Slimy floor
entries.target: 黏滑地面

entries.source: The target is unstoppable! It refuses to die and cannot heal.  When the effect ends, it will heal %d Life (%d%% of maximum life per foe slain during the frenzy).
entries.target: 目标势不可挡！它拒绝死亡，也无法被治疗。效果结束时将回复 %d 点生命（狂乱期间每击杀一个敌人回复 %d%% 最大生命）。

entries.source: Target is marked, leaving them vulnerable to marked shots.
entries.target: 目标被标记，易受针对标记目标的射击技能影响。

entries.source: The target is lit up by a flare, reducing its stealth and invisibility power by %d, defense by %d and removing all evasion bonus from being unseen.
entries.target: 目标被闪光弹照亮，潜行和隐身强度减少 %d，闪避减少 %d 并失去不可见状态带来的闪避加成。

entries.source: Target is protected from dispels
entries.target: 目标受到保护，免遭驱散。

entries.source: Huge cut that bleeds, doing %0.2f physical damage per turn and decreasing all heals received by %d%%.
entries.target: 巨大的伤口不断流血，每回合造成 %0.2f 物理伤害，并使受到的治疗效果降低 %d%%。

entries.source: The target is poisoned and sick, doing %0.2f nature damage per turn. Each time it tries to use a talent there is %d%% chance of failure.
entries.target: 目标中毒且患病，每回合受到 %0.2f 自然伤害，每次使用技能时有 %d%% 概率失败。

entries.source: The target is dazed, rendering it unable to move, halving all damage done, defense, saves, accuracy, spell, mind and physical power. Any damage will remove the daze.
entries.target: 目标被眩晕，无法移动，造成的所有伤害、闪避、豁免、命中、法术、精神和物理强度减半。任何伤害均会打断眩晕效果。

entries.source: The target is encased in ice. All damage done to it will be split, 40%% absorbed by the ice and 60%% by the target. The target's defense is nullified while in the ice, and it may only attack the ice, but it is also immune to any new detrimental status effects (except Wet and Frozen Feet). The target cannot teleport or heal while frozen. %d HP on the iceblock remaining.
entries.target: 目标被冻结在冰块中，对其造成的所有伤害有 40%%被冰块吸收，目标则受到余下的 60%%伤害。冰冻状态下其闪避无效，只能攻击冰块，但同时免疫新的负面状态（湿润和冻足除外）。目标被冻结时无法传送也不能回复生命。冰块剩余 %d HP。

entries.source: #Target# radiates power.
entries.target: #Target#散发着力量。

entries.source: The target is infused with the power of nature, reducing all blight damage taken by %d%%, increasing spell saves by %d, and granting immunity to diseases.
entries.target: 目标得到了自然的力量，受到的所有枯萎伤害减少 %d%%，提升法术豁免 %d，并使其对疾病免疫。

entries.source: #Target# prepares %s!
entries.target: #Target#准备%s！

entries.source: for the next kill
entries.target: 下一次击杀

entries.source: Dragon blood runs through your veins. You can breathe fire (or have it improved if you already could).
entries.target: 龙血在你的血管中流淌。你可以喷吐火焰（如果你原本就会喷火，则吐息会得到强化）。

entries.source: #Target#'s throat seems to cool down.
entries.target: #Target#的喉咙似乎冷却了下来。

entries.target: 目标被削弱，造成的所有伤害降低 %d%%。

entries.source: The target is encased in thorny vines, dealing %d nature damage each turn and reducing its speed by %d%%.
entries.target: 目标被荆棘包裹，每回合受到 %d 自然伤害并减速 %d%%。

entries.source: #Target# is protected by a layer of thick leaves.
entries.target: #Target#被一层厚厚的树叶保护着。

entries.source: #Target# cover of leaves falls apart.
entries.target: #Target#的树叶护层散落了。

entries.source: Parrying melee attacks: Has a %d%% chance to deflect up to %d damage from the next %0.1f attack(s).
entries.target: 招架近战攻击：有 %d%% 几率偏转接下来攻击中至多 %d 点伤害（剩余 %0.1f 次）。

entries.source: Parrying melee%s attacks: Has a %d%% chance to deflect up to %d damage from the next %0.1f attack(s).  Parried attacks cannot crit.
entries.target: 招架近战%s攻击：有 %d%% 几率偏转接下来攻击中的至多 %d 点伤害（剩余 %0.1f 次）。被招架的攻击不会暴击。

entries.source: Blocking up to %d total damage.
entries.target: 总计可格挡至多 %d 点伤害。

entries.source: The target is disabled, reducing movement speed by %d%% and accuracy by %d.
entries.target: 目标已残废，移动速度降低 %d%%，命中降低 %d。

entries.source: #Target# is disabled.
entries.target: #Target#残废了。

entries.source: #Target# defiantly reasserts %s connection to nature!
entries.target: #Target#倔强地重新建立%s与自然的联系！

entries.source: #Target# assumes an extreme defensive posture, avoiding some damage!
entries.target: #Target#进入了极端防守姿态，躲避部分伤害！

entries.source: #Target# has shook off the razorwire.
entries.target: #Target#挣脱了刀片刺网。

entries.source: A bear trap snaps onto #Target#!
entries.target: 捕熊陷阱夹住了#Target#！

entries.source: The target gains 1 extra parry opportunity each turn, and its chance to fail each parry is reduced by %d%%.
entries.target: 目标每回合获得一次额外的招架机会，招架失败率下降 %d%%。

entries.source: Focusing on defense and mobility, reducing all damage taken by %d%%, stamina regeneration by %0.1f and movement speed by %d%%. Melee and ranged attacks will break this effect.
entries.target: 专注于防御与机动，受到的所有伤害减少 %d%%，体力回复增加 %0.1f，移动速度增加 %d%%。近战或远程攻击会终止该效果。
